# Moses Zegbah Zimay

> Moses Zegbah Zimay (Moses Zimay) is an accounting assistant based in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast), focused on audit, internal control and fraud prevention, and building a career in forensic accounting and financial fraud investigation. Since 2022 he has worked in the Finance Department of the Inter-African Coffee Organization (IACO), a 25-member-country coffee producers' organization: multi-currency bank reconciliations (XOF, EUR), preparing the annual statutory audit (MNG Audit & Consulting) and the external audit of a GIZ-funded project (BDO), and bookkeeping on SAGE 100. He has 7+ years of finance and accounting experience (SAGE 100, QuickBooks, Xero, SYCEBNL) and has trained in cybersecurity (penetration testing, brute-force attacks). He is also a full-stack web developer (Django, WordPress/WooCommerce, Shopify). Bilingual in French and English.

- Also known as: Moses Zimay, Zimay Moses, Moses Z. Zimay, Moses Zegbah, Zimay Moses Zegbah
- Roles: Accounting Assistant · Full-stack web developer
- Focus: Audit, internal control & fraud prevention
- Career goal: Becoming a forensic accountant and financial fraud investigation expert.
- Location: Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast)

## Path to forensic accounting
- Certified external audits: prepared IACO's audits by MNG Audit & Consulting and the GIZ project audit by BDO — supporting evidence, auditor requests, accounts certified true and compliant.
- Monthly multi-account, multi-currency bank reconciliations (XOF, EUR) — the first line of defence for spotting anomalies and misappropriation.
- Physical stock counts and fixed-asset verification with formal reports — matching what is recorded to what actually exists.
- Monitoring compliance with financial rules and procedures, cash and per-diem handling, and a full paper trail for every transaction.
- Cybersecurity training (penetration testing, brute-force attacks) to understand digital fraud and how access is protected.

## Professional experience

### Accounting Assistant — Finance Department (permanent contract) — Inter-African Coffee Organization (IACO) (Jan 2024 — Present)
Inter-African organization of 25 coffee-producing member countries that promotes domestic coffee consumption in Africa.
- Accurately recording financial transactions in the accounting system (SAGE 100).
- Helping prepare financial statements, budgets and reports.
- Preparing the annual audit of IACO's accounts (XOF, EUR, asset depreciation) by MNG Audit & Consulting — accounts certified true and compliant for coffee years 2022-2023 and 2023-2024.
- Preparing the external audit of the GIZ project 'Facilitation of the implementation of the living prosperous income commitments', conducted by BDO — accounts certified true and compliant.

### Intern Accounting Assistant — Finance Department — Inter-African Coffee Organization (IACO) (Jan 2022 — Dec 2023)
- Bank journals and petty-cash entries on SAGE; monthly bank reconciliations (BICICI, ECOBANK, GIZ, ICO).
- Updated the fixed-asset register through a physical count, making quarterly depreciation reliable and keeping interim financial statements compliant.
- Preparing internal and external audits and compiling the supporting documents requested.
- Preparing the financial documentation for the Annual General Meeting.

### Accounting Assistant (internship, then role) — International Fellowship of Christians (IFC) (Feb — May 2019)
International English-speaking church in Abidjan founded by missionaries, bringing together 40+ nationalities.
- Bookkeeping on QuickBooks: posting transactions and checking supporting documents are complete.
- Closing the 2018 financial year; contributing to the annual budget, year-end reporting and balance sheet.
- Monthly bank reconciliations on Excel and QuickBooks (GT Bank, Banque Atlantique).
- Asset verification and updating the fixed-asset register through a physical count.

### Administrator & Video Editor — Children's Fruit (Jan 2017 — Feb 2019)
Christian youth organization: films, vacation Bible schools and gospel concerts.
- Preparing and running live streams on OBS (Open Broadcaster Software).
- Annual budget proposal and treasury control.
- Video editing, graphic design and filming evangelism videos for YouTube; actor.
- Planning and running concerts and vacation Bible schools.

### Full-stack web developer & accounting consultant — Freelance (Alongside)
- Full-stack Django platform for Children's Fruit (web TV, community, donations).
- WordPress/WooCommerce and Shopify stores, SEO-optimized product pages.
- E-commerce bookkeeping, ad campaigns and branding for Shopify brands.
